Real NYC disco/dance remixer (M+M mixes) with an extensive, ongoing remix catalogue, but the presenter didn't name the specific track so it can't be pinned down.

rows.title: Valerie
notes: “I'm playing something of yours now... This is a song called Valerie that was written... about Valerie Carter, who was a singer in the 70s.”
1982 Steve Winwood song (lyrics by Will Jennings) widely believed to be a tribute to 1970s singer Valerie Carter, though never fully confirmed by the writers.
